note: Roadmap is indicative, not a commitment — priorities can shift.

items.title: Additional database backends
items.note: Delivered in 0.9.13. Run EVE Console on PostgreSQL instead of the built-in SQLite file, with an in-app test-and-copy that migrates an existing database across — and several clients sharing one server.

items.title: Native Linux support
items.note: Delivered in 0.9.13. First-class, self-updating Linux builds — an AppImage or a tarball — ship alongside the Windows builds with every release.

items.title: Standalone background service
items.note: Delivered in 0.9.13. The ESI polling, importing and alarm work can run headless — on another machine or in a container — as a systemd user unit or Windows service, independent of the desktop client.

items.title: Web-based storefront
items.note: Delivered in 0.9.14. A public web storefront for your in-app store, hosted on your own Cloudflare account: buyers sign in with EVE SSO, browse your price list, and place orders that flow straight into the app.

items.title: Improved Embedded Agent Abilities
items.note: Delivered across 0.9.14–0.9.16. The built-in AI agent knows EVE and the app, works with in-app tools — querying your data, reaching ESI, opening windows, managing alarms — and can use several models with roles and an announced fallback, speaking through a named list of voices.

items.title: Alarms
items.note: Delivered in 0.9.16. The alarms system introduced in 0.9.10, completed: intel around your characters, game log events, ships left undocked, store orders, Planetary Industry and more — announced with sounds and voice, within the hours you choose.

items.title: Multi-language support
items.note: Delivered in 0.9.16. EVE Console in eight languages, chosen in Settings, with item and system names as the game shows them.

items.title: Ship fitting tool
items.note: Delivered in 0.9.16. View and edit your in-game saved fittings and your ships' current fits, and build new ones — slots, modules and charges — assessed against the item, market and skill data EVE Console already holds.

items.title: Planetary Interaction tools
items.note: Delivered in 0.9.16. Track your colonies and extractors, forecast storage and production, see each planet's profit, and get alerts and Worklist tasks for PI chores like restarting extractors and hauling.
